profile_text.body:
Shopify Inc. is a public company headquartered in Ottawa that describes itself as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses. Its site invites businesses to try Shopify free and says they can build or grow quickly with AI, positioning the offering as more than ecommerce software by including tools to manage every part of a business. The company trades under the ticker SHOP and holds SEC CIK 0001594805.

On the AI side, the site describes Agentic Storefronts, which it says lets businesses get discovered across AI channels and lets shoppers check out directly in a chat without the merchant taking action. That is the extent of the AI detail the site provides in the material available.

The record holds no litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers for the company.
